verdict: Lead tracking is broken — zero recorded leads this week is a data issue, not demand.
narrative: This period you received 9 tracked leads at a cost of $281 per lead, but zero leads have been recorded in the last 7 days despite $489 in spend over that stretch — the last tracked lead was August 4th. The evidence points clearly to a conversion tracking failure, not a drop in customer interest: Google Ads logged 17 conversions over 28 days that never connected to your lead count, meaning a significant portion of your results is going uncounted. We're auditing the Google Ads conversion setup now to restore accurate reporting. Once tracking is repaired, your true lead volume for this period should read materially higher than the current 9.
